d:
Around 13.2% of households receiving subsidised foodgrains under the National Food Security Act (NFSA), 2013, do not meet their respective states’ eligibility criteria, a government-commissioned study has found.
The evaluation covered 51,303 beneficiary households across all 36 states and Union Territories.
West Bengal recorded the highest inclusion error at 39.5%, meaning nearly four in 10 surveyed beneficiary households did not meet the state's eligibility criteria.
Nationally, the inclusion error was higher in urban areas (15.6%) than in rural areas (12.5%).
